scope: Local generator, BI Oslo; desktop and 390x844 responsive viewport; synthetic text; no application code changed
method: Hands-on Chrome interaction plus source inspection; expert usability review, not a study with real students

observed.test: 74-character student headline, Elegant Stripe, Large logo
observed.result: Text renders as three heavy centred lines; input stays single-line, no line-break/size/alignment controls
Headline hidden from preview and input disabled with explanation; text preserved when switching back
Headline input below logo controls; preview outside viewport while editing; tiny text in scaled preview
Headline cleared, layout reset to Split and size to Normal
Unconfirmed: browser tool call timed out; do not classify as an app export failure

source_confirmed: Headline single-line input maxLength=100, no character counter
Headline font weight 900 and sizes fixed by layout
No focal-point/crop control in current editor

priorities.feature: Two-line text editor: main line and optional supporting line; live count, presets, 3 sizes, alignment, safe text positioning
priorities.value: Readable personal identity with less trial and error

priorities.feature: Sticky compact preview on mobile, with expand button
Autosave per-school draft and restore/reset; undo/redo
LinkedIn-style profile preview with avatar overlap and desktop/mobile approximations
priorities.value: Inspect text placement before download; label as approximation

priorities.feature: Three complete starting designs using actual school assets and a few student text presets
priorities.value: Faster first good result; validate with student testing

next_validation: Five students: create a banner with study/interest text, change layout, recover draft, download; record time, hesitation, visibility mistakes and completion.
